title: Scientific Target Selection
subtitle: Choose a Mars observation target and build an evidence-based investigation plan.
description: Use available mission context, observation-site information, operational constraints, and scientific datasets to define a focused research question. Submit a target proposal with supporting evidence and explicit limitations.

tasks.title: Review Mission Context
tasks.description: Review the current mission objectives, available operational information, and relevant findings from the Sol 2 readiness assessment.
tasks.completionCondition: The player submits a context review referencing the actual Sol 2 readiness record and identifies relevant constraints.

tasks.title: Investigate Observation Sites
tasks.description: Review available observation-site records and compare candidate targets using supported scientific and operational criteria.

siteSelectionCriteria.label: Scientific relevance
siteSelectionCriteria.description: How well the available site information supports the proposed scientific question.

siteSelectionCriteria.label: Data availability
siteSelectionCriteria.description: Whether usable observations or datasets are available for the site.

siteSelectionCriteria.label: Operational accessibility
siteSelectionCriteria.description: Whether the available terrain and mission information supports access to the site.

siteSelectionCriteria.label: Data quality and uncertainty
siteSelectionCriteria.description: Whether the available data is sufficiently documented and suitable for the intended investigation.

validationRules: Every candidate site ID must refer to an actual available site record.
The selected site must be included among the reviewed candidates.
The rationale must use available site information.
Unknown site properties must remain unknown rather than being invented.

tasks.completionCondition: A valid site comparison is submitted with an evidence-supported provisional site selection.

tasks.title: Review Mission Systems and Constraints
tasks.description: Inspect available communications, systems, and operational information that could affect the planned observation.
tasks.completionCondition: The player submits a constraints review referencing available records and explaining their relevance to the planned observation.

tasks.title: Define a Scientific Target and Question
tasks.description: Select an available observation target and formulate a focused scientific question that can reasonably be investigated with the available evidence.

validationRules: The target ID must reference a real available target record or an explicitly labelled simulation record.
The scientific question must not be empty.
Supporting evidence references must resolve to existing records.
A proposed explanation must not be stored as an established scientific result.

tasks.completionCondition: The player submits a valid target definition and a focused scientific question supported by available information.

tasks.title: Select and Evaluate a Scientific Dataset
tasks.description: Explore the available scientific datasets, inspect their metadata and limitations, and choose a dataset relevant to the proposed target and question.

validationRules: The selected dataset must exist in the actual available dataset catalogue.
Unavailable metadata must be marked unknown or unavailable.
The dataset's stated coverage and measurement type must support the proposed use.
A dataset must not be described as proving a conclusion it does not establish.

tasks.completionCondition: The player submits a dataset assessment referencing an available dataset and explaining its suitability and limitations.

tasks.title: Submit the Scientific Target Proposal
tasks.description: Review the selected target, scientific question, dataset, supporting evidence, operational constraints, and known limitations. Submit the final investigation plan.

validationRules: The target and dataset must be relevant to the proposed question.
Known limitations must be retained in the final record.
The proposal must not claim a scientific result that has not been established.

tasks.completionCondition: The proposal passes validation and is saved as the player's final Sol 3 scientific investigation plan.
